title: Shagan Manawaan
body:
Haaye Qasim..
Haaye Qasim Mera Banra, Haaye Haaye Qasim..
Shagan Manawaan, Shagan Manawaan..
Haye Qasim De Main Sehrey, Hanjwaan De Naal Sajawaan..
Shagan Manawaan, Shagan Manawaan..
1) Shagna Di Mehndi Wich Maa,
Hanjwaan Nu Ghool Ke Aakhay,
Tere Shaghan Manawan Qasim,
Kiwein Sehrawan De Pyasay,
Riya Khaimiyaan Wich Na Pani,
Kiwein Mehndi Ghool Liyawan..
2) Inna Ataina Wali,
Kausar Da Boha Man Ke,
Kis Khaimiyo Qasim Toraan,
Baraat Te Janji Tere,
Lailatul Qadar Da Wehra,
Kehra Khaimay Putar Banawaan..
3) Si Phul Barsan Da Wela,
Jadon Lara Ban Wich Aaya,
Aidhey Tukriyaan Te Ummat Ne,
Aidhey Shaghan Da Jashan Manaya,
Te Sir Te Kitiyaan Lokaan,
Teraan Pathraan Di Chawaan..
4) Meri Teraan Saal Di Mehnat,
Wich Karbal Rang Le Aayi,
Tainu Deen Dua Waan Banra,
Khatoon-E-Janat Aayi,
Kawe Zakhmi Pehlu Dadi,
Tainu Banra Aap Banawaan..
5) Mehndi Nu Rang Charhaway,
Akbar Da Zakhmi Seena,
Khushiyaan Da Rang Wadhaway,
Asghar Da Teer Te Hasna,
Baraat Nu Rasta Dassan,
Ghazi Diyaan Katiyaan Bawaan..
6) Tainu Jang Di Deen Ijazat,
Taveez E Hasan Le Aayi,
Main Veer Hussain Te Zainab,
Di Saan Bewah Bharjayi,
Mera Adab Hamaish Nibhaya,
Aina Dowaan Bhain Bhirawaan..
7) Akbar Aye Wain Si Maa Da,
Tere Piyo Di Qabar Te Ja Ke,
Dewaan Gi Tera Pursa,
Teri Jang Da Haal Suna Ke,
Ik Wari Qaid Nibha Ke,
Main Watan Te Wapis Jawaan..
